instruction: A full shot cinematic still of a grassy outdoor backyard surrounded by green trees. On the left, the woman in the crochet vest (R2) is blindfolded with a peach bandana, holding a wooden bat and swinging it forward. In the background center, the woman in the pink shirt (R1) stands watching with a smile. On the right, the man in the patterned tee (R3) wears white shorts and sneakers, watching excitedly with his hands raised. The blindfolded woman swings the wooden bat at a red heart-shaped pinata hanging from above, while her friends stand nearby watching and reacting. The scene is illuminated by bright daylight filtering through the trees.
